name: PixelTrail-TS-TW
title: Pixel Cursor Trail
description: The pointer paints stair-stepped white squares onto a black panel; each burst holds a moment then dissolves, leaving a blocky trail behind the cursor.
use: A game, devtool or retro page wants a blocky cursor trail with arcade energy.
avoid: It only appears while the mouse moves, and the coarse white blocks can cover fine text.
a11y: Decorative and pointer-only; nothing appears for keyboard users and reduced-motion is not checked. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black panel with faint grey "Move your cursor" text. The pointer leaves a cluster of hard-edged white squares snapped to a coarse grid, forming stepped blocky clouds.
behaves: Moving the pointer stamps pixels into a grid that widen into blocky clumps, then fade out over about a quarter of a second. Nothing moves unless the mouse moves.
customise: Grid size, trail radius, pixel lifetime, interpolation, easing, pixel colour and an optional gooey blur filter are props. There is no content.
weight: moderate: A small three.js canvas draws one shader plane and a 512-pixel trail texture.
